doc_title_en: Notice of Public Disclosure of Q&A Regarding E-Guardian Inc. Second Quarter FY2026 Results and Full Subsidiary Acquisition of Outsourcing Communications Inc.
doc_title_jp: 2026年９月期第２四半期決算及び株式会社アウトソーシングコミュニケーションズの完全子会社化に関するＱ＆Ａ公開のお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: バックオフィスやセールス/マーケティング、情シスBPOなど様々なBPO領域への進出。AI-BPOモデルの展開。

summary_en: E-Guardian announced Q&A disclosure regarding the acquisition of Outsourcing Communications (OSCOM) as a wholly owned subsidiary, pursuant to a share transfer agreement executed on 2026-05-22. Deal value, purchase price per share, and acquisition timing not disclosed in this Q&A document. The acquisition marks E-Guardian's entry into new BPO domains (back-office, sales/marketing, IT systems) and reflects strategy to deploy the AI-BPO model across M&A targets to convert labour-intensive operations into high-margin recurring revenue.
summary_jp: イー・ガーディアンが2026年5月22日に締結したアウトソーシングコミュニケーションズの完全子会社化について、Q&Aを公開。買収額・株価は本資料では未開示。新規BPO領域（バックオフィス、営業・マーケティング、情シス）進出の第一歩であり、AI-BPOモデルを展開して労働集約型から高収益型へ転換を目指す。

summary_en: Acquisition of Outsourcing Communications finalized June 1, 2026. E-Guardian now holds 100% stake (1,100 shares, full voting control). Contact center operator established March 2018, capital 55M yen. Financial impact on FY9/2026 results under review.

summary_en: Share purchase agreement executed to acquire all shares of Outsourcing Communications (contact center business only) from BREXA Technology, targeting full subsidiary status. Acquisition scheduled for June 2026. Non-contact-center businesses transferred to BREXA Group in April 2026.
